missingToken.title: Add a Mapbox token to see the map
missingToken.intro: The map is drawn with Mapbox, which needs a free access token. The weather data comes from Open-Meteo and needs no key.
missingToken.stepAccount: Create a free account at {link} and copy your default public token (it starts with {prefix}).
missingToken.stepEnv: In the project folder, copy {example} to {env} and paste the token after {variable}
